title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 Review: A Huge Leap Forward
description:
Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 just released, so I put it through my usual set of practical tests against Gemini 3.8 Flash and other current models.

I test video understanding with a Twitch stream social media critique, structured list generation, customer support replies, browser game coding, tiny animations, particle effects, and a historical armor UI challenge. Most results - including an impressive version of the cybertruck rally game - are evidence of a staggering improvement over Muse Spark 1.2.

Muse Spark 1.3 sets itself apart from other popular models by being capable of much more natural sounding writing and cost efficiency, and is now very competitive in coding ability as well.
